question.problem:
The change-of-coordinates matrix from the basis $B$ to the basis $C$ and the coordinates of the vector $x$ relative to the basis $B$ are given below. What is $[x]_{C}?$ 

$$
{P}_{B\to C}=[\begin{aligned}2 & -8 \\ -5 & 3\end{aligned}],\,[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 2\end{aligned}]
$$
question.worked_solution:
Given the coordinates of $x$ relative to $B$ and the change-of-coordinates matrix from $B$ to $C,$ we find the coordinates of $x$ relative to $C$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[\,x\,]_{C} & ={P}_{B\to C}[\,x\,]_{B} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2 & -8 \\ -5 & 3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-22 \\ 21\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
